title: Algebra 2: Sequences & Series
tagline: From recursive rules to sums that run forever — sigma notation, Gauss's fold, and the trick that tames infinity.

chapters.title: Recursive vs Explicit
chapters.description: Two ways to give a sequence rule — the step-by-step chain and the jump-anywhere formula — and how to convert between them.

chapters.title: Sigma Notation
chapters.description: Read, evaluate, and write sums in Σ form — the counter, the bounds, the rule, and the fencepost count.

chapters.title: Arithmetic Series
chapters.description: Gauss's pairing fold, the two sum formulas, and series in the wild — theaters, stacks, and savings plans.

chapters.title: Finite Geometric Series
chapters.description: Why the fold fails on multiplied terms, the shift-and-subtract trick, and S = a₁(1 − rⁿ)/(1 − r).

chapters.title: Infinite Geometric Series
chapters.description: When adding forever settles down — the |r| < 1 test, S = a₁/(1 − r), repeating decimals, and bouncing balls.
